summary: Pull requests run a per-commit kit play set of about 60 seconds instead of every critical story; merge groups still run every story in four cases with axe.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: CI-only change to which kit plays a pull request runs; no application, API or user-visible behavior change.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the critical-story set on pull requests; nothing to recover.
